name: Evangelisches Studienwerk: Scholarship for Students With Refugee Status
summary: The scholarship is aimed at refugees who are studying at German institutions of higher education. Candidates from all disciplines and subjects are welcome to apply. The grant amount is of up to 855 EUR each month plus 300 EUR flat rate for
